Psi Upsilon Fraternity held its 159th
Convention in Florida at the Marriott
Marco Island Resort and Golf Club,
June 22-25, 2002.
Legislation adopted by the Convention
included modifications to the Psi Upsilon
Financial Responsibility Policy. To assist
chapters having difficulty collecting dues
and meeting financial obligations to the
International Fraternity, the Budget and
Development committee recommended that
chapters adopt the services of outside
financial agencies such as Omega Financial or Automated Payment Highway (APH)
to assist with the collection of funds.
Delegates amended the Psi Upsilon Constitution to
provide for the election of the two undergraduate
delegates to the Executive Council by the Convention. The Convention also requested that the Executive Council establish a committee to examine the
possibility of creating Fraternity-wide standards for
philanthropy and community service.
Delegates determined that the 2004 meeting will be
held in Williamsburg, Virginia to honor the 20th
anniversary of the Phi Beta chapter (William & Mary ).
Presenters at the 2002 Leadership Institute
included Nonnie Cameron Owens and John Spence.
Owens is a business etiquette consultant whose
sessions included " Gaining a Competitive Advantage"
and a luncheon where she discussed the details
of personal and professional etiquette. Spence, a
Fortune 100 company consultant, delivered an
impressive keynote address about goal setting for
success in college and beyond.

Ceremony, brothers Robert and Evelyn Kaiser (Zeta '37
and '85-Honorary) received the Distinguished Alumni
Service Award for their 37 years of stewardship to
